title: Zero space with no work tapes
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet and let $f$ map Boolean words to Boolean words. If $M$ has no work tapes and for every Boolean input $x$ there exists a time at which it halts with output $f(x)$, then $M$ computes $f$ using space bounded by zero on every input.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$f$ maps Boolean words to Boolean words
For every Boolean input $x$, $M$ computes $f(x)$ within some time
